# Vendored browser libraries

These files are served by the admin console so that it works without a network connection
and without a Node toolchain. They are unmodified copies of the published builds.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx (https://htmx.org) | 2.0.4 | Zero-Clause BSD |
| `lightweight-charts.js` | TradingView Lightweight Charts (https://www.tradingview.com) | 4.2.3 | Apache License 2.0 |
